tasks.short: Diagnose and treat pediatric developmental or organic conditions

steps.what: Review developmental history, school observations and existing assessments with their original dates and authors
inputs: authorized existing pediatric records and school reports

steps.what: Assess the child using appropriate measures and observe behavior and administration limitations
outputs: actual assessment findings with validity limitations

steps.what: Determine the developmental or organic diagnosis and appropriate treatment with the child and caregivers
inputs: actual assessment findings with validity limitations
outputs: clinician's diagnosis and agreed treatment approach

steps.what: Deliver the selected pediatric treatment and adjust to the child's actual response
inputs: clinician's diagnosis and agreed treatment approach

steps.what: Write and check the pediatric clinical record with diagnostic uncertainty, treatment and actual response
inputs: clinician's diagnosis and agreed treatment approach
actual assessment findings with validity limitations

steps.what: Save the checked pediatric record in the same clinical system

tasks.design: Configure a dated source view in {OPS_SYSTEM} for developmental history and school reports. The clinician checks original material, assesses and treats the child, and authors the clinical record; the view supplies no diagnosis or new findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant observations can sit in different dated record sections and attachments.
tasks.enabler_now: Native encounter and document filters can bring existing sources together.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing developmental variation, learning disability and organic impairment in an individual child.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt assessment and treatment to the child and family.

ambition.what: No automated pediatric diagnosis or treatment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical record views can filter existing observations by date and source; pediatric diagnosis and treatment require clinical assessment.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record; OTHER is authorized neuropsychological assessment software. Existing authors produce source reports before this task; unavailable school reports remain missing, not inferred.
Native filters first. Assessment entry and existing scoring assistance are retained in s2. Clinical note authoring and same-system save are explicitly retained, without extra self-approval work.
Shares are provisional work scenarios, not measured baselines or the prompt's time prior. Only source navigation changes: gross 2 minus 0.3 view upkeep gives 1.7 net.
unknowns: Current source navigation burden and availability of native chronology filters
research_questions: Does a configured source view reduce navigation while retaining developmental dates and informant attribution?

already_counted.description: Check source chronology and attribution during review

approvals.approved_version: complete checked pediatric record at end of s5; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if the native view is already sufficient; cautious range below provisional 1.7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide education and counseling to individuals and families

steps.what: Read the relevant patient context and choose suitable existing educational material
outputs: clinician-selected context and material for this family

steps.what: Provide education or counseling, invite questions and check the individual's and family's understanding
inputs: clinician-selected context and material for this family
individual's and family's actual concerns and questions
outputs: education or counseling delivered and actual understanding observed

steps.what: Document and check counseling content, actual concerns, understanding and agreed follow-up in the encounter record
inputs: education or counseling delivered and actual understanding observed

steps.what: Save the checked counseling note in the same clinical record

tasks.design: Use native counseling encounter headings in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reduce repeated formatting. The clinician supplies and checks the actual counseling content; no template claims that a topic was covered or understood.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generic free-text note may require repeated headings and encounter metadata entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical templates can supply headings and existing encounter identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to distress, misunderstanding and differing family needs.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and adapt the explanation during the conversation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical encounter templates can reduce repeated formatting while the clinician supplies and checks counseling observations.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record. The scenario includes normal clinical encounter documentation; confirm this is part of the local task rather than a separately counted report.
Use native headings first; no recording, inferred family understanding, additional capture form or automated educational send. Ordinary checking remains inside note authoring.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 0.9 minus 0.2 template upkeep gives 0.7 net; same-system save remains fully retained at 1%.
unknowns: Whether existing counseling templates already provide all useful headings
research_questions: Does a native template reduce formatting without encouraging copied or unobserved counseling claims?

already_counted.description: Author and check the actual counseling note

approvals.approved_version: complete checked counseling note at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if the current template suffices; cautious range below provisional 0.7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Distinguish competing neurobehavioral etiologies and seizure-related disorders

steps.what: Review source histories, test findings and available neurologic investigations with dates and limitations
Distinguish psychogenic and neurogenic syndromes, competing cerebral etiologies or complex seizure disorders using the actual evidence
outputs: clinician's differential conclusion, alternatives and uncertainty

steps.what: Write and check the differential formulation with supporting findings, contradictory evidence and diagnostic limitations
inputs: clinician's differential conclusion, alternatives and uncertainty

steps.what: Save the checked differential formulation in the same clinical system

tasks.design: Retain source review, differential judgement and formulation in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Existing test software supplies its normal scored findings; neither a template nor a language model can resolve the competing etiologies from these inputs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Competing etiologies require interpretation of inconsistent and incomplete clinical evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record and test views already support evidence access; no additional labor-saving change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing validity, contradictions and the limits of the differential conclusion.
tasks.human_edge: Own diagnostic reasoning and express uncertainty rather than force a label.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: differential neuropsychological formulation requires clinical interpretation of history and findings; software scoring alone does not establish etiology.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record; OTHER is authorized assessment software. Actual source authors and existing test administration produce the inputs; no new structured capture is assumed.
Source lookup, written formulation and save are split explicitly. Native filters and formulation headings are considered already available in this scenario; no additional reduction is justified.
The diagnostic reasoning and its written explanation remain substantive work. Shares are provisional, not measured; all retained, gross and net zero. No send is assumed by this task statement.
unknowns: Whether the current source review includes avoidable navigation rather than substantive reading
research_questions: Observe one differential formulation to distinguish navigation from necessary evidence interpretation.

already_counted.description: Write and check the substantive differential formulation

incremental.description: No new system or maintenance work

approvals.approved_version: complete checked differential formulation at end of s3; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported change to source interpretation or substantive formulation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose and treat neural and psychological conditions in medical and surgical patients

steps.what: Evaluate medical and surgical history, neuropsychological findings, symptoms and the patient's actual functional difficulties
inputs: patient's actual symptoms and functional account

steps.what: Diagnose the neural and psychological condition and choose an appropriate treatment approach
outputs: clinical diagnosis and treatment decision with uncertainty

steps.what: Deliver the selected treatment for the patient's neurological and psychological difficulties and observe response
inputs: clinical diagnosis and treatment decision with uncertainty
outputs: actual treatment delivered and response observed

steps.what: Write and check the clinical encounter record covering findings, diagnosis, treatment and response
inputs: clinical diagnosis and treatment decision with uncertainty
actual treatment delivered and response observed
outputs: complete checked medical or surgical clinical encounter note

steps.what: Save the checked clinical encounter note in the same record
inputs: complete checked medical or surgical clinical encounter note

tasks.design: Configure encounter headings and existing episode identifiers in {OPS_SYSTEM} for medical and surgical neuropsychology. The clinician supplies the findings, diagnosis and treatment response, finishes checking the note and saves it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Generic encounter notes can require repeated formatting and episode identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical templates can retain useful structure without generating clinical content.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding early cognitive change or neurologically based pain and choosing treatment for this patient.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate medical context and respond to the patient's experience.

ambition.what: Keep diagnosis and treatment with the clinician.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native encounter templates can supply headings and episode identifiers while clinical diagnosis, treatment and note checking remain human work.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the clinical record; OTHER is authorized assessment software. Source clinicians and actual assessment produce history and findings. This is a clinical encounter scenario, not a separate report-writing assignment.
Native templates first. No inference of treatment completion or improvement from the plan. Existing assessment scoring and clinical source review are retained.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 0.9 minus 0.2 template upkeep gives 0.7 net. Save is 1% fully retained, and checking occurs within ordinary note authoring.
unknowns: Existing note template quality and actual formatting burden
research_questions: Does an episode-specific native template remove repeated formatting while preserving clinical uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Author and check the encounter record against actual care

approvals.approved_version: complete checked clinical encounter note at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where existing headings suffice; cautious range below provisional 0.7% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Clinical record administrator can configure existing views and headings; no diagnosis is transferred.
skills_to_grow: Check native templates for copied clinical claims
role.ambitious_version: Improve source access and reduce repeated note formatting while keeping pediatric and medical neuropsychological diagnosis, treatment and counseling with clinicians.
